description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application. It manages the TV's home screen UI, including top menu navigation, horizontally scrolling content rails, focus handling with D-pad navigation, and content loading via ViewModel.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity representing the TV application's home screen, handling focus navigation, loading content rails, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and triggers content loading.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top menu bar, assigns click and focus behaviors.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Sets up content rails, loads data into each, and manages focus navigation with D-pad remapping.

methods.name: handleDpadUpWithinRails
methods.description: Handles remapping of focus when the user presses D-pad UP within content rails; maps focus to the item directly above or maintains boundary.
